reproducer.recommendation: Documented, not a defect: a hard-threshold penalty is a fence by design (see #159 Stage 1 RESULTS.md for the full transect). A gradient MAP search initialised inside the fence sees zero signal from positions until a lane actually reaches the boundary.

findings.subject: likelihood
findings.summary: Sweeping einstein_radius in [0.0, 3.0] (401 pts, threshold=0.3, factor=1e+08), a tight (+/-1e-6) probe at each of 2 max_sep==threshold crossing(s) shows the penalty VALUE is continuous there (max gap 2.006e+02) while its jax-autodiff GRADIENT jumps by up to 2.006e+08 — zero on the interior side, nonzero on the exterior side. A gradient optimizer sees a step-function force switching on at the fence, not a smooth potential.
findings.title: PositionsLH penalty has a C0 hinge at the threshold crossing
